# Finding service accounts and service principals: a pinned copy of Learn's commands

This folder is an unmodified copy of three Microsoft Learn source pages: [Secure user-based service accounts in Active Directory](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/architecture/service-accounts-user-on-premises), [Secure group managed service accounts](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/architecture/service-accounts-group-managed) and [Securing service principals in Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/architecture/service-accounts-principal). They hold Microsoft's commands for finding user accounts used as service accounts (`Get-ADObject` for delegation, `Get-ADUser` for SPNs and passwords that never expire), managed service accounts (`Get-ADServiceAccount`) and service principals (`Get-MgServicePrincipal`). They come from [MicrosoftDocs/entra-docs](https://github.com/MicrosoftDocs/entra-docs/tree/7f78b50dce9d8cf119de57cbd6fd66e24a6c58d4/docs/architecture) at commit `7f78b50dce9d8cf119de57cbd6fd66e24a6c58d4` (October 30, 2026); all three pages last changed on February 25, 2026. The repository's code license (`LICENSE-CODE`) and documentation license (`LICENSE`) are both MIT.

**Why the pages, not just the commands.** The commands exist only inside these Learn pages. Pinning the pages byte for byte keeps the copy checkable against upstream. `examples/non-person-identity/tests/LearnSampleHarness.ps1` extracts the commands, unmodified, at test time and runs them against stand-ins for the Active Directory and Microsoft Graph PowerShell cmdlets. Nothing is installed and nothing signs in. The [developer workbook *Building Non-Person Identity*, Chapter 01](../../../docs/project-plans/developer-workbooks/non-person-identity/01-non-person-identity-inventory-as-code.md) links Learn rather than quoting the pages.

**How it stays honest.**

- `snapshot.json` records the upstream repository, paths, commit, dates, licenses and the size and SHA-256 of every file here. Each file's git blob hash was checked against the upstream tree at that commit before the manifest was written. `scripts/tests/test_third_party_snapshots.py` fails if any file is changed, added or removed.
- The weekly source watch follows commits to each upstream page (`entra-service-accounts-user-page-commits`, `entra-service-accounts-gmsa-page-commits` and `entra-service-accounts-principal-page-commits` in `data/source-watch/feeds.json`) and reports each one in its issue under DW (developer workbooks).
- To move to a newer upstream commit: review the upstream change, copy the pages from that commit, regenerate `snapshot.json`, rerun `examples/non-person-identity/tests/MicrosoftSamples.Tests.ps1` and the Chapter 01 labs, and open a pull request. Never edit the files here; changes the program needs go in `examples/non-person-identity`.

These files keep their upstream bytes, line endings included, so the hashes match the upstream commit.
